title: paged-kv-age-buckets-with-sticky-stream-pinning
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: under mixed latency-throughput workloads the paged KV cache has seen repeated hotset churn where short-lived peaks evict blocks belonging to steady low-throughput streams. This PR introduces a page-aware age-bucket allocator plus a lightweight per-request sticky pin heuristic to reduce unnecessary reclaims and improve end-to-end tail latency and CPU utilization. Summary of changes: 1) age-bucket allocator: split free/pinned free lists into 4 age buckets based on last-access epoch to bias reuse toward recently used blocks and prefer eviction from oldest buckets; 2) per-stream sticky pinning: when a request stream accesses more than N sequential pages we mark a lightweight sticky pin token for that stream for M seconds so subsequent nearby allocations prefer previously-resident blocks and avoid KV fetch churn; 3) soft-reserve fastpath: introduce a per-worker fast reserve that can hand out small contiguous spans without global lock for latency-sensitive allocations; 4) eviction hinting API: add hint payloads to eviction scorer so callers (e.g., scheduler) can prioritize eviction when under transient load; 5) metrics and tracing: new histograms for "kv.alloc.latency_ms" and per-bucket occupancy gauges plus trace spans for sticky-pin lifecycle; 6) tests and benchmarks: microbench harness for mixed read/write streams and an end-to-end canary config used in perf-canary repo. Backwards compatibility: allocator keeps same public behaviour; sticky-pin tokens are internal and time-bounded. Checklist: [x] design doc linked [x] unit tests [x] bench scripts [x] e2e canary config [x] metrics added [x] rollout plan included. Rollout plan: staged canary -> 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on sustained tail latency regressions. Related work: follows principles from ENG-4819 (KV cache reclaim refactor) and complements pr-129876 lazy-reservation work. No user-facing API changes.

review_thread: Ethan Cho (2025-11-07): High-level this looks good; can you quantify expected memory overhead for the extra bucket lists?
Sofia Martinez (2025-11-07): The extra pointers are ~8 bytes per page; for a 128GB working set this is ~64MB and we include a feature flag to disable buckets if memory is constrained.
Priya Nair (2025-11-08): Request change: the sticky-pin lifetime needs a backoff when a stream becomes cold to avoid permanent reservations. Please add exponential decay.
Sofia Martinez (2025-11-08): Added exponential decay to token TTL and added test to validate token expiry under intermittent traffic.
Marco Liu (2025-11-09): CI flaky on allocator_tests.rs on macOS runner, appears due to timing in bench harness; suggested using a polling loop with deadline instead of fixed sleeps.
Sofia Martinez (2025-11-09): Updated tests to use deadline-based waits; re-ran CI.
Ethan Cho (2025-11-11): Approved and verified perf numbers in canary: 95th latency down ~18% and CPU sys% down ~7% for mixed workload W-2. Marking ready to merge.
release_notes: Add a page-aware age-bucket allocator and per-stream sticky pinning to reduce KV cache churn and improve tail latency and CPU efficiency; metric and tracing additions included
